daily_summary: 当日 vLLM 变更聚焦六个方面：(1) 注意力子系统：新增 Triton/FlashAttention（Hopper）与 Triton/FlashInfer（Blackwell）组合后端，将多模态 prefix 的图像双向注意力路由到 Triton、因果 prefill/decode 路由到高性能后端，并扩展 AttentionBackend 抽象（supports_rswa、get_impl_variants、use_rswa 参数）；(2) 稳定性修复：NVFP4 权重 scale 未加载的 NaN 哨兵检测、混合 KV cache 加载失败恢复、KV offload 无 forward 步的 CPU store 提交、Gemma4 视频预处理隔离、多模态 UUID 保留、pooling 实际 token 统计；(3) DeepSeek V4.1 Engram 增强：DP 共享内存表、异步预取、engram DP 通信组、默认 CPU offload，并修复 dummy 权重重复初始化、支持 dummy_weight_value 常量填充；(4) 性能：DSA sparse indexer 集成 DeepSelect TopK 并抽象可配置的 top-k 后端；(5) 回退显式 Triton JIT warmup 迁移（MRV2）；(6) 其他：benchmark 流式延迟统计一致性修复、ROCm 默认启用 DeepSeek V4.1 breakable CUDA graphs、DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision LoRA 支持。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更对 vllm-ascend 的影响主要落在注意力后端抽象与 GPUModelRunner 继承链上：AttentionBackend 新增 supports_rswa/get_impl_variants 及 validate_configuration 的 use_rswa 参数（向后兼容扩展，但 Ascend 注意力后端需确认签名兼容）；GPUModelRunner 的 pooling 断言放宽与 JitWarmupRegistry 回退直接影响继承它的 NPUModelRunner；Scheduler 混合 KV cache 失败恢复修复惠及使用混合 KV cache 的 Ascend 调度路径；DSA sparse indexer 的 top-k 重构对 Ascend 保持 per_row 回退；DummyModelLoader 变更影响所有平台的 dummy 权重加载。DeepSelect（CUDA SM100）、Engram（CUDA 门控）、simple_kv_offload（CUDA）、Gemma4、ROCm 配置、benchmark 与 serving 层变更均不影响 Ascend。

commits.comment: 该 bugfix 针对 NVFP4 (modelopt) 量化路径：将 weight_scale 参数初始化为 NaN 哨兵值（而非 torch.empty 的未定义垃圾值），并在 process() 阶段检测仍为 NaN 的 weight_scale，抛出带修复建议的 RuntimeError。这样当 checkpoint 将某层保存为 BF16 而 weight loader 静默跳过 FP4 权重加载时，能被明确识别而非产生未定义行为。变更局限在 vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/modelopt.py 的 KNvfp4Static 类中，是 NVIDIA FP4 量化特有的保护逻辑。

commits.comment: 大型功能变更，为多模态 prefix attention 引入可复用的组合注意力后端机制。核心是新增 vllm/v1/attention/backends/composite.py，提供 create_composite_attention_backend 工厂和 MMPrefixAttentionRouting 路由策略，将双向图像注意力路由到 Triton、因果文本 prefill/decode 路由到 FlashAttention (Hopper, TRITON_FLASH_ATTN) 或 FlashInfer (Blackwell, TRITON_FLASHINFER)。同时在 AttentionBackend 抽象上新增 supports_rswa() 类方法和 AttentionImplBase.get_impl_variants()（默认返回 (self,)），validate_configuration 增加 use_rswa 参数，AttentionSelectorConfig 增加 use_rswa 字段；CudaPlatform._get_backend_priorities 在 use_mm_prefix 时把组合后端插入优先级列表。风险点：AttentionBackend 接口签名扩展影响所有后端实现（虽然均带默认值，向后兼容）；组合后端要求两个子后端 KV cache spec 完全一致，且支持特性受限（无 DCP/PCP/R-SWA 等）。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/attention/backend.py 是必然影响路径。AttentionBackend 新增 supports_rswa() 类方法（默认 False）、AttentionImplBase 新增 get_impl_variants()（默认返回 (self,)）、validate_configuration 新增 use_rswa 关键字参数，AttentionSelectorConfig 新增 use_rswa 字段，均向后兼容。但 Ascend 注意力后端若覆写 validate_configuration 且未接受 use_rswa 参数，在带 R-SWA 的模型（如 DeepSeek V4.1）选择后端时会因传参不匹配失败；get_attn_backend 现在会把 model_config.rswa_window 传入 selector，NPUPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls 需要能处理新增字段（NamedTuple 尾部带默认值，属性访问兼容）。Triton/FlashAttn/FlashInfer 组合后端本身是 CUDA 特性，与 Ascend 无关。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游新增 attention selector 与 mm_prefix 组合后端测试（CUDA 门控）。Ascend 无需运行这些 CUDA 用例，但需验证现有注意力后端在新增接口参数下选择/校验路径正常。

commits.comment: 修复混合 KV cache 下 KV 加载失败（invalid block）时 Scheduler 的 ValueError。原实现假设每个 request 只有一个 block id 列表（单 KV group），混合模型（full attention + Mamba、DeepSeek-V4 的五 group 布局）各 group block size 不同，同一 block index 在不同 group 中对应不同 token 位置，无法找到统一截断点。修复策略：多 group 请求直接整体重算（num_computed_tokens 置 0），并放入 WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS；同时将各请求共享的 null block 排除在失效判定与 eviction 之外。新增大量单测覆盖 hybrid 与 DeepSeek-V4 场景的 recompute/fail 两种策略。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py 是 Ascend 调度路径（vllm-ascend 的 AscendScheduler 或直接用基类 Scheduler）的核心文件。变更让 invalid-block 扫描支持多 KV cache group：混合 KV cache（不同 group block size 不同）下不再尝试找统一截断点，而是整请求重算；并排除所有请求共享的 null block，避免误触发重算或 eviction。使用混合 KV cache（如 MLA+SWA+Mamba 多 group）和 KV connector 的 Ascend 场景继承此修复；若 vllm-ascend 自定义调度器覆写了该扫描方法，需同步实现多 group 与 null block 处理。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游新增 hybrid 与 DeepSeek-V4 五 group KV cache 的失败恢复单测。vllm-ascend 如有自定义调度器，可参考补充多 group 失效块场景测试，但非强制。

commits.comment: 大型功能变更，为 DeepSeek V4.1 的 Engram n-gram embedding 增加两大能力：(1) DP 共享内存（dp_shared_memory）：node 内 co-located DP replica 通过 /dev/shm mmap + cudaHostRegister 共享一份 CPU-offload 的 embedding 表，按 TP 切片映射，避免每 replica 独立副本和每步 DP collective；(2) 异步预取：CPU offload 模式下在专用 CUDA side stream 上提前发起 UVA lookup，并通过 eager_break_during_capture 配合 breakable CUDA graph。此外引入 engram DP 通信组（parallel_state 新增 _ENGRAM_DP）、gather_engram_hashes DP padding、dummy_hashes 用于无 hash 元数据的 replica 参与 collective；VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD 默认改为 1；VllmConfig 对 DeepSeekV41 + DBO/microbatching 报错。NVIDIA 实现（nvidia/engram.py）使用 CUDA 特有 API（cudaHostRegister/UVA），公共部分（config/parallel_state/common engram）用 is_cuda() 门控。变更量大且涉及分布式组初始化、共享内存生命周期（finalizer 反注册）、多线程 weight loader 同步等，风险较高。

commits.comment: 修复 dummy 权重初始化中的两个问题：(1) DummyModelLoader 原先对每个 layer 调用 initialize_dummy_weights(layer) 递归初始化所有子孙模块，导致被 model.modules() 多次访问的模块被重复随机初始化；现在改用 get_layer_tensors(layer) 只初始化当前层的直接 tensor（排除 non-persistent buffer），与 state_dict 语义对齐。(2) initialize_single_dummy_weight 新增对参数上 dummy_weight_value 属性的支持，命中时用常量填充而非随机数。Engram CPU offload 表据此设置 dummy 值（weight=1.0, scale=127），避免对巨大的 CPU 查找表做随机初始化。行为变更影响所有平台的 dummy 加载路径（profile/warmup）。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/model_executor/model_loader/ 在可能影响路径。DummyModelLoader 从递归初始化全部子孙模块改为只初始化当前层直接 tensor（与 state_dict 对齐，排除 non-persistent buffer），initialize_single_dummy_weight 新增 dummy_weight_value 常量填充支持。所有平台（含 Ascend）在 profile_run/dummy 权重加载时的初始化行为发生变化：避免重复随机初始化，且带 dummy_weight_value 的参数会用常量填充（当前仅 Engram CPU offload 表使用，CUDA 相关）。对 Ascend 的 NPUWorker.load_model 是兼容性 bugfix，不破坏现有接口。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游未新增专门测试（依赖现有 dummy 加载测试）。vllm-ascend 无强制测试变更。

commits.comment: 修复流式 benchmark 中 TTFT/E2E 延迟统计不一致的问题。核心改动：TTFT 统一用 chunk 到达时间戳 timestamp - st 计算（tgi/completions 之前混用 perf_counter 与 timestamp）；chat/audio 端点只有携带 token 的 chunk 才推进 most_recent_timestamp（记录请求结束），尾部 usage chunk 不再拉长 latency；只有至少收到一个 token chunk 才标记 success，纯 usage 流报错。这保证 serve.py 推导 TPOT 时（latency - ttft）== sum(itl) 的恒等式成立。新增基于脚本化时钟和假 SSE session 的精确计时测试（含 legacy backend_request_func.py）。

commits.comment: 回退显式 Triton JIT warmup 迁移（MRV2）。主要变化：(1) GPUModelRunner.__init__ 移除 @JitWarmupRegistry.capture 装饰器，jit_warmup_registry 改为普通实例属性，加载模型/初始化 sampler/KV cache 处的 activate() 调用保留但不再依赖装饰器注入；(2) 移除 _dummy_run 中对 rejection_sampler 的预热；(3) SamplingStates 不再调用 register_top_k_top_p_warmups；(4) DFlash/MultiModuleMTP speculator 的 triton_kernel_dispatcher_with_warmup 包装全部移除，改为在调用处直接 launch kernel（prepare_dflash_inputs 等函数返回值从 DispatchSpec 变为 None）；测试将 idx_mapping dtype 从 int64 改为 int32。回退后 Triton kernel 依靠实际运行时参数 JIT 编译而非显式 warmup spec，降低框架复杂度但可能影响首次调用的编译延迟。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 是必然影响路径。回退后 jit_warmup_registry 从装饰器注入变为普通实例属性（GPUModelRunner.__init__ 中直接创建），NPUModelRunner 继承后初始化流程兼容；移除 _dummy_run 中 rejection_sampler 预热与 SamplingStates 的 register_top_k_top_p_warmups，spec decode 的 Triton warmup 方式改变。DFlash/MultiModuleMTP speculator 的 kernel 从带 warmup 的 dispatcher 改回直接 launch，prepare_dflash_inputs/_shift_input_ids/_shift_input_embeds 的返回值签名变化（DispatchSpec→None），且 idx_mapping dtype 预期为 int32。vllm-ascend 的 spec_decode 目录包含 DFlash 实现，若其继承上游 DFlashSpeculator 或直接调用 prepare_dflash_inputs，需适配新的直接 launch 语义与 idx_mapping dtype。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游更新 dflash prepare inputs 测试（idx_mapping int64→int32）与 speculator mock。vllm-ascend 若有 DFlash/MTP 用例，建议同步验证 idx_mapping dtype 与 kernel 启动路径。

[6/N][warmup][DSv4] Migrate sampling, and DFlash JIT kernels (#56323)

Signed-off-by: Lucas Wilkinson <lwilkins@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: LopezCastroRoberto <rocastro@redhat.com>
Co-authored-by: Lucas Wilkinson <lwilkins@redhat.com>
Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <codex@openai.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit (part of the [N/N][warmup][DSv4] series) migrates sampling (topk_topp, rejection sampler) and DFlash Triton JIT kernels to the new `triton_kernel_dispatcher_with_warmup` + `register_warmup()` infrastructure, and makes GPUModelRunner.__init__ (both v1 `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py` and v2 `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py`) a `@JitWarmupRegistry.capture` context. Required vllm-ascend adaptations:

1. **CRITICAL - DFlash kernel patch is silently broken.** Upstream `prepare_dflash_inputs` in `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py` is now a `_DecoratedTritonJitKernel` that captures the module-level `_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel` at import time. The Ascend patch `dflash_speculator._prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel = _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend` (patch_v2/patch_triton.py:45) therefore no longer affects runtime launches: the wrapper's `launch()` always uses `self.kernel` (the upstream kernel). `AscendDFlashSpeculator.propose()` -> upstream `DFlashSpeculator.propose()` -> `prepare_dflash_inputs(...)`, so the Ascend-specific NPU kernel (per-request padding to max_num_reqs, `block_idx>0` early return, PAD_SLOT_ID CG safety) is silently replaced by the upstream kernel, which now does block-tiling + DCP `cp_local_slot` + null-block handling. Fix: follow the new patching pattern used by upstream's own CPUModelRunner (`vllm/v1/worker/cpu_model_runner.py` now sets `spec_decode_utils._eagle_prepare_inputs_padded.kernel = ...`): replace line 45 with `dflash_speculator.prepare_dflash_inputs.kernel = _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend` and confirm the main2main variant of `_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend` still binds via the new dispatch spec (`cp_rank`/`SAMPLE_FROM_ANCHOR`/`CP_SIZE`/`CP_INTERLEAVE` are filled by `_prepare_launch_kwargs` name-based binding; `PAD_SLOT_ID`/`BLOCK_SIZE` come from the dispatch dict). Validate ACL-graph capture on NPU after rebinding.

2. **JIT warmup registrations become active on the v2 model runner.** Because the v2 `GPUModelRunner.__init__` is now `@JitWarmupRegistry.capture` (NPUModelRunner calls `super().__init__`), `register_top_k_top_p_warmups()` (from `TopKTopPSampler.__init__` and `SamplingStates.__init__`), `RejectionSampler.__init__`'s `_rejection_*`/`_expand`/`_sample_recovered_tokens.register_warmup(...)`, `SpecDecodeBaseProposer.__init__`'s eagle warmups, and `DFlashSpeculator.__init__`'s `prepare_dflash_inputs.register_warmup(speculator=self)` all register during Ascend init. These are inert today only because `vllm_ascend/model_executor/warmup/kernel_warmup.py` never calls `model_runner.jit_warmup_registry.warmup()`. Confirm no plan to enable it (the warmup providers reference upstream CUDA-oriented kernels and `_triton_key_deriver` Triton internals that may not work on the triton-ascend backend); if parity with upstream warmup is desired, gate it per-platform or keep it disabled for NPU.

3. **`_dummy_sampler_run` now invokes the rejection sampler.** Upstream `_dummy_run` (inherited by NPUModelRunner, which calls `super()._dummy_run`) now calls `self.rejection_sampler(logits, dummy_input_batch, self.speculator.draft_logits)` during warmup on spec-decode runs. Verify this path works with the upstream/`AscendRejectionSampler` on NPU (dummy InputBatch, draft logits dtype) — especially under lmhead-TP and ACL-graph warmup on the v2 path.

4. **scatter_states is now a decorated wrapper** (`vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/ops/scatter_states.py`). The existing Ascend sweep in `vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_triton.py` (replaces `scatter_states` with `_npu_scatter_states` on the source module and all loaded modules) still works because it rebinds the module attribute and late `from ... import` gets the npu function; but the sweep runs at patch time, so verify `vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/kda.py` is loaded before/after the sweep and that it always ends up calling the npu function (the decorated object's `__call__` would launch the upstream kernel using `tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait`, which is NPU-unsupported). The upstream `register_warmup()` call added in `vllm/models/glm5next/nvidia/kda.py` is NVIDIA-only and not reached on Ascend.

5. **No changes needed for**: Ascend v1 spec-decode (`vllm_ascend/spec_decode/*`, uses its own `copy_and_expand_dflash_and_dspark_inputs_kernel`, `npu_copy_and_expand_eagle_inputs`, and the plain-function module replacements in `patch_rejection_sampler.py` / `patch_triton.py` for `apply_top_k_top_p_triton`, `rejection_sample`, `expand_batch_to_tokens` — all still plain functions post-commit); MTP speculator (`_shift_input_*` wrappers, ascend doesn't use `multi_module_mtp`).
deep_analysis.risk: Medium-high. (1) The DFlash `_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel` substitution in patch_v2/patch_triton.py:45 is a silent no-op after this commit, so the upstream kernel (block-tiled, DCP-aware, no Ascend max_num_reqs padding) is used on NPU for DFlash v2 spec decode; this can break ACL-graph capture/accuracy or change slot-mapping behavior on Ascend and requires immediate patch rewrite plus on-hardware validation. (2) If vllm-ascend ever enables `jit_warmup_registry.warmup()`, the newly registered sampling/DFlash warmup providers would compile upstream kernels on NPU (wasteful/possibly unsupported on the triton-ascend backend); today they are inert but add registrations during init. (3) The new rejection-sampler call inside `_dummy_sampler_run` changes warmup behavior for spec-decode runs on NPU. (4) scatter_states sweep timing vs. decorated wrapper remains an ordering-sensitive patch that should be regression-tested.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) rejection_sampler_utils (mandatory, low-effort): extend npu_rejection_sample in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/rejection_sampler_utils.py with the new keyword-only params contexts: torch.Tensor | None = None, watermarking: torch.Tensor | None = None, watermark_key: int | None = None. Keep them None in the default path; if any is set, either raise NotImplementedError (NPU has no watermarked resample kernel) or implement the keyed-recovery resample. Update the npu_rejection_sample bindings in vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py accordingly (the patch is unconditional, so this commit makes the mismatch reachable now that _check_watermarking_unsupported allows dual_key_gumbel + dspark/eagle/eagle3/mtp). 2) gumbel.py: verify the Ascend gumbel_sample/apply_temperature remain signature-compatible with the new RandomSampler.__call__ and GPUWatermarkSampler (they are; note use_fp64 already raises NotImplementedError on NPU). 3) Speculators: no change is required for the default (draft_watermarker=None) path, since Ascend specs do not override _sample_parallel/_sample_sequential and prepare_watermarking() is a no-op; if NPU watermarking is to be supported, ensure AscendDSparkSpeculator/AscendDFlashSpeculator honor the upstream draft/target role keying. 4) NPU watermarking enablement (optional, medium/high): if dual_key_gumbel is supported on NPU, the GumbelWatermarker already falls back to the torch path (device.type != 'cuda'), but repeated_context_mask() (default deduplicate_contexts='single_turn') launches the new _repeated_context_mask_kernel Triton kernel on any non-CPU device — its tl.int64/uint32/loops need triton-ascend validation or a CPU/Ascend fallback. Otherwise, add explicit config validation in vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py (or NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config) to reject --watermark on NPU with a clear error instead of crashing.
deep_analysis.risk: Low for existing functionality: all new paths (GPUWatermarkSampler construction, prepare_watermarking calls in model_runner, draft_watermarker in speculators, WatermarkConfig fields, _check_watermarking_unsupported validation) are guarded so the default non-watermark path on NPU is fully backward compatible. Medium for watermarking+spec-decode on NPU, which this commit makes reachable (dual_key_gumbel is now explicitly allowed with dspark/eagle/eagle3/mtp, and previously gumbel+spec-decode was rejected): vllm-ascend's patched npu_rejection_sample would raise TypeError on the unexpected contexts/watermarking/watermark_key kwargs, and the repeated_context_mask Triton kernel may be unsupported by triton-ascend. Also note the watermarked rejection path is a new behavioral change to the shared rejection_sample interface that must not be silently dropped by the NPU patch.
